checks.check: C1 unit consistency: E / sigma_max between 1e2 and 1e5 for a metal at working stress
checks.evidence: E = 2e+11 with stresses in MPa gives E/sigma = 2.33e+09; deflection 0.00000 mm vs 4.008 mm expected (factor 2308647)

checks.check: C2 global equilibrium: clamp reaction equals applied load within 1e-6
checks.evidence: reaction 500 N vs 500.0 N applied (necessary, not sufficient)

checks.check: C3 mesh convergence of the reported quantity: < 5 % change under 4x refinement
checks.evidence: reported max stress 85.8 -> 138.5 MPa from 10 to 2.5 mm elements (+62 %)

checks.check: C4 reported maximum is not read at a point load or a constraint edge (singular locations)
checks.evidence: max at node 10 at x=0, y=10, z=20 mm; load node = 14 -> clamp face

checks.check: C5 hand-calculation plausibility: sigma_max within 25 % of M c / I and deflection within 20 % of beam theory
checks.evidence: sigma_max 85.8 MPa vs M c / I = 150.0 MPa; deflection 0.00000 mm vs 4.008 mm

checks.check: C6 element formulation suited to bending: no linear tetrahedra (C3D4) in a bending-dominated part
checks.evidence: C3D4 used; on the same mesh sizes the top-fibre stress at x = 2H reaches only 120 MPa of the 135 MPa expected (see refinement table)

checks.check: C7 correct strength criterion: static safety factor of a ductile part is based on yield, not ultimate
checks.evidence: SF = S_ut / sigma = 5.01 reported; with S_y = 275 MPa and the beam-theory root stress the factor is 1.83

checks.check: C8 load application: resultant applied as a distributed traction or coupling, not a single nodal force on a solid mesh
checks.evidence: single *CLOAD on node 14; stress at that node grows 14 -> 57 MPa with refinement (singular)
